card.name: Hyphen or period before a number
card.fires_on: A hyphen inside a hyphenated term in a dosing table, or a sentence-ending period just before a number or new sentence in warnings text. Often the next thing is a digit such as a section number or dose.

modes.label: Hyphen in table term
modes.description: The hyphen inside a hyphenated infection name in a dosing table, right before the next word and numbers.

modes.label: Period ending a warning sentence
modes.description: The period that ends a sentence in warnings, often followed by a section number like 5.7 or a new sentence.

card.writes: It lowers the odds that the next token is a digit, so numbers are less likely to follow.
card.plain: It marks the point where a hyphen or full stop is followed by something other than a number, such as a word or a new sentence.
